_comment: Curated, static reference of privacy / removal resources for the self-exposure audit. These are starting points the user should verify before acting; URLs and procedures change over time. Nothing here is queried automatically.

breach_check.name: Have I Been Pwned
breach_check.note: Check whether an email address or phone number appears in known data breaches, and subscribe to be notified of future ones.

breach_check.name: Firefox Monitor
breach_check.note: Breach-exposure lookup and monitoring for an email address.

search_engine_removal.name: Google - Results about you
search_engine_removal.note: Request removal of search results that expose your contact info (phone, home address, email), and monitor for new ones.

search_engine_removal.name: Google - Remove outdated content
search_engine_removal.note: Ask Google to refresh or drop cached pages that still show information deleted at the source.

search_engine_removal.name: Bing - Content removal
search_engine_removal.note: Report personal information or outdated cached pages for removal from Bing.

data_brokers.name: Spokeo
data_brokers.note: People-search broker. Find your listing, then submit the URL to opt out.

data_brokers.name: Whitepages
data_brokers.note: Suppress your listing; may require phone verification.

data_brokers.name: BeenVerified
data_brokers.note: Search for your record and opt out.

data_brokers.name: Intelius
data_brokers.note: Opt out of Intelius and several affiliated people-search sites.

data_brokers.name: TruePeopleSearch
data_brokers.note: Free people-search site with a direct removal form.

data_brokers.name: FastPeopleSearch
data_brokers.note: Removal form; locate your record first.

data_brokers.name: PeopleFinders
data_brokers.note: Opt-out form for the PeopleFinders listing.

data_brokers.name: Radaris
data_brokers.note: Claim and control (hide) your Radaris profile.

data_brokers.name: MyLife
data_brokers.note: Submit a CCPA deletion / opt-out request.

data_brokers.name: Instant Checkmate
data_brokers.note: Opt out of this background-report broker.

data_brokers.name: US Search
data_brokers.note: Opt-out form for the US Search listing.

data_brokers.name: Acxiom
data_brokers.note: Large marketing-data broker; opt out of its data products.

data_brokers.name: LexisNexis
data_brokers.note: Opt out where eligible (e.g. law-enforcement / FCRA criteria apply to some data).

guidance.name: EFF - Surveillance Self-Defense
guidance.note: Practical guides on account security, data minimization and protecting yourself from doxxing.

guidance.name: Access Now Digital Security Helpline
guidance.note: Free help for people facing targeted harassment or account compromise.
